Bu omborda hali kirim yo‘q..en: This warehouse has no receipts yet.

Asl qator o‘chirilmaydi — teskari yozuv.en: The original row is not deleted — a reversing entry is added.

Qoldiq = kirim − rasxod; rasxod kiritilg.en: Balance = receipts − issues; until issues are entered the balance is not calculated — only receipts are shown below.

Storno faqat yozilganidan keyin 24 soat.en: Reversal is only possible within 24 hours of posting.

Yozib bo‘lmadi. Aloqani tekshirib, «Davo.en: Writing failed. Check the connection and press «Continue».

Asl faylni saqlab bo‘lmadi. Qayta urinib.en: Could not store the original file. Try again.

Yozildi: {yangi} ta yangi qator. Takror.en: Written: {yangi} new rows. Duplicates (skipped): {takror}. Errors (not written): {xato}.

Fayl 25 MB dan katta — serverda tekshiri.en: The file is larger than 25 MB — the server cannot verify it. Make the file smaller.

Tahrirlangan, lekin tasdiqlanmagan qator.en: Edited but unconfirmed rows are not written: {soni}

Fayl serverda tekshirilmadi (25 MB dan k.ru: Файл не проверен сервером (больше 25 МБ или не сохранён). Попробуйте файл поменьше.
Fayl serverda tekshirilmadi (25 MB dan k.en: The file was not verified by the server (over 25 MB or not stored). Try a smaller file.

Ombor topilmadi yoki bu kompaniyaga tegi.en: Warehouse not found or belongs to another company.

Bu bo‘lak avval boshqacha yuborilgan. Fa.en: This batch was previously sent differently. Re-select the file and re-check duplicates.

Bu kompaniyada omborga yozish huquqingiz.en: You do not have permission to write to the warehouse in this company.

Bu qatorlar allaqachon yozilgan. Takrorl.en: These rows are already written. Re-check duplicates.

Omborni ko‘rish uchun «Hujjatlarni ko‘ri.ru: Для просмотра склада нужно право «Просмотр документов».
Omborni ko‘rish uchun «Hujjatlarni ko‘ri.en: Viewing the warehouse requires the «View documents» permission.
